Navigate to the [ImmPort repository](https://www.immport.org/shared/search?text=SDY3080). You will need to create a free account, login, and go through the two-factor authentication process before being able to download dataset. 

Once through the login process, search for [SDY3080](https://www.immport.org/shared/search?text=SDY3080), which is the SFC dataset associated with our [Rach et al. 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2025.1628145/full) *Frontiers in Immunology* paper looking at Cord Blood Innate-Like T cell responses in neonates born to healthy women and women living with HIV. The full-stained cord blood samples were stimulated for intracellular cytokines with PMA-ionomycin, and then stained with a 29-fluorophore spectral flow cytometry panel. 

![](images/00_SDY3080.png)

Proceed to select the SDY3080 repository

![](images/01_ClickSDY3080.png)

And from there select the Study Package from web option

![](images/02_StudyPackageWeb.png)

Proceed into the Results Folder

![](images/03_ResultsFolder.png)

Proceed into the Flow Cytometry Results sub folder

![](images/04_FlowCytometryFolder.png)

Change the number of displayed files to maxinum

![](images/05_ChangePageDisplay.png)

Proceed to select the files of interest. The ILT_00 was a collection of bead single-color controls acquired before the experimental series start. The first experiment is denoted by ILT_01, and consist of the single color reference controls, specimen specific by condition unstained samples, and then the full-stained samples (Ctrl, Ctrl Tetramer, PMA)

![](images/06_ILT00and01.png)

Proceed to the Download Cart option

![](images/07_DownloadCart.png)

Agree to the Download

![](images/08_YesDownload.png)

Wait for the download to begin

![](images/09_WaitingScreen.png)

If successful, save the folder to your desired location. Then proceed to extract the contents

![](images/10_ExtractZippedFolder.png)

For our walk-through, we are choosing to organize the extracted out files directly under the following folders

![](images/11_DataFolderOrg.png)

And here is an example of the original file sizes

![](images/12_OG-SC-Cell-Size.png)

And an example of the original file sizes for the bead controls. 

![](images/13_OG-SC-Bead-Size.png)
